notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Another Round by paying {2}{W}, blinking Dockside Extortionist and Donnie & April.
When Dockside Extortionist and Donnie & April enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.
